bios: Upstream GPL-2.0 open BIOS; full corresponding sources in gpsp/bios/source
changes: Bound ROM cache to the PXA budget; skip optional 4 MiB mini-ROM materialization
Bridge cartridge reads to PXA positional I/O and propagate read errors
Use the portable ARM/Thumb interpreter; no native JIT inside the PXA guest
Expose pending mixer samples for exact PXA snapshot replay, outside the BSON size cap
Fix sound savestate validation loop counters so every channel is checked
Remove ROM-config stdout logging; use the PXA frontend log without WASI stdio
Split portable ARM/Thumb dispatch into mode-local loops to simplify Wasm control flow
Publish NZCV at observable boundaries instead of before every emulated instruction
Optional compile-time phase and instruction-region profiling; no release hot-path counters
Use interpreter-only plain RAM/halfword-word VRAM stores while retaining canonical I/O, palette, OAM and byte-VRAM side effects
Express mapped read alignment in Wasm offsets and bounds-check out-of-bus block reads before indexing the page table
Scan backup signatures in one pass with first-byte filtering, preserving unaligned and tail signatures and type precedence
Optional deterministic frame-block benchmark with PCM/video/CPU checksums excluded from measured core time
Size the cartridge cache to the ROM and caller budget, up to 2 MiB, with a 1 MiB allocation fallback and lazy page fill
Coalesce proven side-effect-free ARM/Thumb polling within one hardware-event slice, preserving the final partial iteration

Fuse verified ARM interpolated/direct stereo mixing and endpoint/count-based copy sequences, reuse IWRAM validation until stores/events, and preserve bus cycles, NZCV, palette conversion, OAM dirty tracking and writable-code behavior
Keep interpreter cycle budgets local until slice exit and share nontrivial ARM operand shifters while preserving inline immediate LSL
Reject ordinary branches before polling analysis; prove short Thumb load/compare fixed points against current memory and NZCV at each event slice
Fuse checked halfword CpuSet loops within hardware-event budgets, preserving overlap order, mapping boundaries, fallback reads, palette/OAM effects and mirrored writable code
